name: Dovin Baan
oracle_text:
+1: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -3/-0 and its activated abilities can't be activated.
−1: You gain 2 life and draw a card.
−7: You get an emblem with "Your opponents can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps."
blocked_sentences: +1: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -3/-0 and its activated abilities can't be activated.

needs.what: a `duration: "until_your_next_turn"` on `pump`, so a -3/-0 set by a planeswalker's loyalty ability lasts through the opponent's turn and is cleared in the controller's next untap step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `pump` carries no duration in its implementation (op_pump always calls `pump`, an until_eot TempEffect cleared at cleanup), so the -3/-0 would expire before the opponent's turn -- exactly when the card matters

needs.what: a `duration: "until_your_next_turn"` on `lock_abilities` ("its activated abilities can't be activated until your next turn"), cleared in the granting player's untap step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `lock_abilities` takes only `objects` and records an until_eot TempEffect, so the lock ends at this turn's cleanup and the opponent can activate freely on their turn
